title: CI jobs cancelled after 15min waiting for a runner, showing red on PRs indistinguishable from real failures
symptom: Jobs queue, are never assigned a runner, and are cancelled ~15min later, surfacing as a red X identical to a genuine failure.
root_cause: Runner starvation (capacity/scheduling), compounded by cancel-in-progress cancelling runs that never acquired a runner. Not a code defect.
acceptance_criteria: Add per-job timeout-minutes so starvation fails fast and legibly
Distinguish 'never scheduled' from 'failed' in the PR view
Confirm over 10 runs that red means a real failure
notes: Measured: last 40 runs = 31 success, 6 cancelled, 3 failure. Only 3 are genuine code failures.
run 31125795191 had 4/4 jobs never start; 31127727011 had 2/4.
Separate from the continue-on-error masking defect (ISS-0171), which hides real failures rather than fabricating false ones.
